scores.rationale: Program durations and costs are provided, but no named option has a concrete scheduling fact tied to preserving regular family time.
No option-level comparison distinguishes protecting family time from learning that dominates evenings or weekends.
Recommendations use cost, equity, traction, skills, and network access as fit factors, but do not use preservation of family time.
The recommended plan explicitly assigns venture-building work to weekends without acknowledging a family-time trade-off or providing protections for regular family time.
